author: Humblares
body:
The moderator MasterProX I think should be demoted for Inactivity. If you go to his profile(https://avicus.net/Masterprox) Then you can see where it shows his kills that he killed someone 2 months ago!. I've never saw him online so I don't know I just think that some other people should get the chance to help support a server and not this person because of their activity. I can name people that I see almost everyday when I play and I think that They deserve that experience too.


Please If you find anyone of my information incorrect please contact me or replay to this thread THANKS.

——————————

I'm currently on a leave of absence — very busy with schoolwork right now especially since I'm almost done with high school — and thus temporarily excused from active staffing of the server and other Avicus services, though I still participate in Slack on a daily basis. Also, your argument is flawed because my gameplay statistics are not an accurate representation of my activity; I was last online moderating one month ago, yet have not scored a kill in two months because of computer hardware issues. Furthermore, there is no specific limit to how many moderators there may be on the staff team at any given time, so I am not "taking up a spot" by staying here.
 
Sincerely,
Andrew (MasterProX)
